The migration is complete. Summary of what changed:

**New App Router structure (`app/`)**
- `layout.tsx` — replaces `_app.js` + `_document.js`; uses `next/font/google` instead of manual `<link>` font tags, `metadata` export for `<head>` content
- `error.tsx` — replaces `_error.js` (client error boundary with `reset()`)
- `not-found.tsx` — replaces `pages/404.js`, using `Link` instead of `useRouter().push`
- `page.tsx` — replaces `pages/index.js`; `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component using `headers()` (now async) for the user-agent
- `blog/page.tsx` — replaces `pages/blog/index.js`; `getStaticProps({ revalidate: 60 })` → `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })`
- `blog/[id]/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` — replaces `pages/blog/[id].js`; `getStaticPaths`/`getStaticProps` → `generateStaticParams`/`generateMetadata` + per-fetch revalidate; `notFound: true` → `notFound()`; `router.isFallback` → `loading.tsx`
- `api/posts/route.ts`, `api/posts/[id]/route.ts` — replace the Pages API handlers with typed `GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE` route handlers using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` and awaited `params` (Next 16 async params)

**Supporting changes**
- `components/AppProvider.tsx` — converted to TS, marked `'use client'` (required now that it's used from a Server Component tree)
- `components/BackButton.tsx` — new client component for the one remaining imperative navigation (`router.back()`)
- `lib/types.ts` — shared `Post`/`Comment` types
- `app/globals.css` (moved from `styles/`), added a `.button` class so nav `<Link>`s can look like the old `<button>`s
- Deleted `pages/`, `styles/`, and the old `.js` provider

Verified with `tsc --noEmit`, `next build` (correct route types: `ƒ /`, `○ /blog` ISR, `● /blog/[id]` SSG with 10 pre-rendered paths, `ƒ` API routes), and a live `next start` smoke test of `/`, `/blog`, `/blog/1`, 404 handling, and all three API methods.
